cesm-atm.title: CESM-ATM
cesm-atm.description: Climate simulation with the Community Earth System Model (CESM), atmosphere component (CAM). Single precision.

2d.description: 2D fields of one time step on a 1800 x 3600 latitude-longitude grid.

2d-cleared.description: The 2D fields with all background (fill) values set to 0.

exaalt.title: EXAALT
exaalt.description: Molecular dynamics simulation (EXAALT, ECP): atom positions (and velocities for 'small'). Single precision, little-endian.

small.description: One snapshot of 2,869,440 atoms: positions xx, yy, zz and velocities vx, vy, vz.

copper-1.description: Copper system, trajectory 1: positions x, y, z of 3137 atoms over 5423 time steps (time x atom).

copper-2.description: Copper system, trajectory 2: positions x, y, z of 1077290 atoms over 83 time steps (time x atom).

helium-1.description: Helium system, trajectory 1: positions x, y, z of 1037 atoms over 7852 time steps (time x atom).

helium-2.description: Helium system, trajectory 2: positions x, y, z of 106711 atoms over 2338 time steps (time x atom).

hurricane-isabel.title: Hurricane ISABEL
hurricane-isabel.description: Hurricane Isabel (September 2003) simulated with the WRF weather model: 100 x 500 x 500 grid (z, y, x), 48 hourly time steps, single precision. Some fields also come log10-transformed.
hurricane-isabel.source: NCAR; released for the IEEE Visualization 2004 Contest (http://vis.computer.org/vis2004contest/data.html)
hurricane-isabel.acknowledgment: Hurricane Isabel data produced by the Weather Research and Forecast (WRF) model, courtesy of NCAR, and the U.S. National Science Foundation (NSF).

snapshot.description: All 13 variables at time step 48, plus 7 log10-transformed ones.

QGRAUP.description: QGRAUP at all 48 time steps. Stored in the SDRBench QCLOUDf archive (there is no separate QGRAUPf archive).

CLOUD_log10.description: log10 of CLOUD at all 48 time steps.

QCLOUD_log10.description: log10 of QCLOUD at all 48 time steps.

QGRAUP_log10.description: log10 of QGRAUP at all 48 time steps.

QICE_log10.description: log10 of QICE at all 48 time steps.

QRAIN_log10.description: log10 of QRAIN at all 48 time steps.

QSNOW_log10.description: log10 of QSNOW at all 48 time steps.

exafel.title: EXAFEL
exafel.description: X-ray free-electron laser images from the LCLS instrument (SLAC): events x detector panels x rows x columns.

small.description: 10 events of the 32-panel detector as raw counts: raw, dark (background) and calib-fde frames, unsigned 16-bit.

large.description: 986 calibrated events of the 32-panel detector, single precision.

assembled.description: 130 assembled 1480 x 1552 detector images with Bragg peak positions and counts per event.

hacc.title: HACC
hacc.description: Cosmology N-body simulation (HACC, ECP ExaSky): particle coordinates xx, yy, zz and velocities vx, vy, vz as separate 1D arrays, single precision, little-endian.
hacc.citation_extra: Please cite Heitmann et al., Astrophys. J. Suppl. 252 (2021) 2, 19 (https://inspirehep.net/literature/1799008) when using HACC data.

sbig.description: One region (1/768) of time step 499 of a trillion-particle run: coordinates only.

region1.description: Region 1840: coordinates xx, yy, zz over about 100 time steps (the particle count changes per step) and the particle IDs.

region2.description: Region 20000: coordinates xx, yy, zz over about 100 time steps (the particle count changes per step) and the particle IDs.

region3.description: Region 24120: coordinates xx, yy, zz over about 100 time steps (the particle count changes per step) and the particle IDs.

region4.description: Region 30210: coordinates xx, yy, zz over about 100 time steps (the particle count changes per step) and the particle IDs.

region6.description: Region 4529: coordinates xx, yy, zz over about 100 time steps (the particle count changes per step) and the particle IDs.

nyx.title: NYX
nyx.description: Cosmology: adaptive-mesh hydrodynamics + N-body simulation (Nyx), 512 x 512 x 512, single precision, little-endian.

original.description: Six fields: baryon and dark-matter density, temperature, velocities.

log.description: The same fields with the two densities log10-transformed (recommended for visualization).

nwchem.title: NWChem
nwchem.description: Two-electron repulsion integrals over Gaussian-type orbital basis sets, computed with libint (Valeev group, Virginia Tech), an integral engine of NWChemEx; 1D arrays.
nwchem.source: libint (https://github.com/evaleev/libint), Valeev research group, Virginia Tech

default.description: Three integral sets (631, acd, ccd), double precision, plus a reader (readbin.cpp).

f32.description: The same integrals as single-precision copies.

scale-letkf.title: SCALE-LETKF
scale-letkf.description: Weather simulation from the SCALE-RM model with LETKF data assimilation (RIKEN): 12 variables on 98 x 1200 x 1200 (z, y, x), single precision, little-endian.

log.description: The hydrometeor and vapour mixing ratios log10-transformed; the other variables unchanged.

qmcpack.title: QMCPACK
qmcpack.description: Many-body ab initio Quantum Monte Carlo (QMCPACK): 288 einspline orbitals on a 115 x 69 x 69 grid, single precision, little-endian.
qmcpack.source: QMCPACK performance test; contact Ye Luo (yeluo@anl.gov)

preconditioned.description: (orbital, x, y, z) = (288, 115, 69, 69): each orbital is a contiguous, smooth 3D block. This is the layout of the SDRBench command examples (einspline_288_115_69_69.pre.f32); computed on load from the stored file.

original.description: The layout QMCPACK uses in memory: (x, y, z, orbital) = (115, 69, 69, 288), orbital index fastest.

miranda.title: Miranda
miranda.description: Rayleigh-Taylor instability simulated with LLNL's Miranda hydrodynamics code.

small.description: 7 fields of a 256 x 384 x 384 subdomain at an early time, double precision. pressure, viscocity and diffusivity are legacy (incorrect) names of time-derivative restart fields.

big.description: One 3072^3 single-precision density field at a late time, stored as 96 slabs density/00 ... density/95 of 32 x 3072 x 3072; ds.series('density').concatenate() joins them (116 GB).

s3d.title: S3D
s3d.description: Statistically planar premixed methane flame simulated with S3D (SNL): 11 variables on 500 x 500 x 500, double precision, little-endian.

default.description: 5 time steps (t = 1.1e-3 ... 2.995e-3 s). Each stored file holds all 11 variables (variable x z x y x x); fields are zero-copy views per variable: mass fractions CH4, O2, CO, CO2, H2O, N2; temperature T (normalized by 120 K), pressure P (by 1.41837e5 Pa), velocities U, V, W (by 347.2 m/s).

basilisk-turbulence.title: Basilisk-Turbulence
basilisk-turbulence.description: 2D decaying turbulence at Re = 10,000 simulated with Basilisk (http://basilisk.fr/): velocity components u, v over time, single precision, little-endian. The first time step is an all-zero placeholder.
basilisk-turbulence.source: M. Xia, Y. Li, P. Jiao, B. Wang, X. Liang and H. Guo, "Time-Varying Vector Field Compression with Preserved Critical Point Trajectories," IEEE ICDE 2026, pp. 2235-2249, doi:10.1109/ICDE65706.2026.00168

small.description: 1024 x 1024 grid, 1501 time steps: shape (time, y, x).

large.description: 2048 x 2048 grid, 1001 time steps: shape (time, y, x).

xgc.title: XGC
xgc.description: Gyrokinetic fusion plasma simulation (XGC, PPPL): fields on an unstructured mesh of 20694 nodes x 512 toroidal planes, 9 time steps, double precision.

raw.description: Raw binary arrays extracted from the ADIOS files: per time step dpot, iden (20694 x 512), pot0, potm0 (20694); mesh arrays prefixed mesh_.

adios.description: The original ADIOS BP files (not raw arrays; read them with ADIOS).
